an10.93:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.93:1.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati divādivassa Sāvatthiyā nikkhami Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.93:1.3: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa etad ahosi
an10.93:1.8: yan nūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkameyyan' ti.
an10.93:2.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkami. 2.
an10.93:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṅgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentā nisinnā honti.
an10.93:2.3: Addasaṃsu kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
an10.93:2.5: ‘Appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddam akattha.
an10.93:2.6: Ayaṃ Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āgacchati samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvako.
an10.93:2.7: Yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā Sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati.
an10.93:2.8: Appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino,
an10.93:2.9: app eva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā' ti.
an10.93:3.1: Atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ. 3.
an10.93:3.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena te paribbājakā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi,
an10.93:3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ te paribbājakā etad avocuṃ
an10.93:3.5: ‘Na kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavato sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāmī' ti.
an10.93:4.1: ‘Iti kira tvaṃ gahapati na samaṇassa Gotamassa sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi,
an10.93:4.3: ‘Bhikkhūnaṃ pi kho ahaṃ bhante na sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāmī' ti.
an10.93:5.1: ‘Iti kira tvaṃ gahapati na samaṇassa Gotamassa sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi, na pi bhikkhūnaṃ sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi,
an10.93:5.3: ‘Etaṃ kho bhante amhehi na dukkaraṃ vyākātuṃ yaṃdiṭṭhikā mayan ti,
an10.93:5.4: iṅgha tāva āyasmanto yathā sakāni diṭṭhigatāni vyākarontu, pacchā p' etaṃ amhehi no dukkaraṃ bhavissati vyākātuṃ yaṃdiṭṭhikā mayan' ti. 4.
an10.93:6.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro paribbājako Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca
an10.93:6.2: ‘sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti
an10.93:7.1: Aññataro pi kho paribbājako Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca
an10.93:7.2: ‘asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti
an10.93:8.1: Aññataro pi kho paribbājako Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca
an10.93:8.8: hoti cana ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā . . .
an10.93:8.9: neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti
an10.93:9.1: Evaṃ vutte Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati te paribbājake etad avoca:--
an10.93:9.3: ‘sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti
an10.93:9.5: imassa ayam āyasmato diṭṭhi attano vā ayonisomanasikārahetu uppannā paraghosapaccayā vā.
an10.93:9.6: Sā kho pan' esā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṃkhatā cetayitā paṭiccasamuppannā;
an10.93:9.7: yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhatam cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tad aniccaṃ,
an10.93:9.9: yaṃ dukkhaṃ, tad eva so āyasmā allīno, tad eva so āyasmā ajjhūpagato.
an10.93:10.1: Yo p' āyaṃ bhante āyasmā evam āha
an10.93:10.2: ‘asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti
an10.93:10.4: imassa pi ayam āyasmato diṭṭhi attano vā ayonisomanasikārahetu uppannā paraghosapaccayā vā.
an10.93:10.5: Sā kho pan' esā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṃkhatā cetayitā paṭiccasamuppannā;
an10.93:10.6: yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tad aniccaṃ,
an10.93:10.8: yaṃ dukkhaṃ, tad eva so āyasmā allīno, tad eva so āyasmā ajjhūpagato.
an10.93:11.1: Yo p' āyaṃ bhante āyasmā evam āha
an10.93:11.8: hoti ca na ca hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā . . .
an10.93:11.9: neva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato parammaraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti
an10.93:11.11: imassa pi ayam āyasmato diṭṭhi attano vā ayonisomanasikārahetu uppannā paraghosapaccayā vā.
an10.93:11.12: Sā kho pan' esā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṃkhatā cetayitā paṭiccasamuppannā;
an10.93:11.13: yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tad aniccaṃ,
an10.93:11.15: yaṃ dukkhaṃ, tad eva so āyasmā allīno, tad eva so āyasmā ajjhūpagato ti. 6.
an10.93:12.1: Evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avocuṃ
an10.93:12.2: ‘vyākatāni kho gahapati amhehi sabbeh' eva yathā sakāni diṭṭhigatāni,
an10.93:12.4: ‘Yaṃ kho bhante kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tad aniccaṃ,
an10.93:12.6: yaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ "n' etaṃ mama n' eso 'ham asmi na me so attā" ti
an10.93:13.1: ‘Yaṃ kho gahapati kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tad aniccaṃ,
an10.93:13.3: yaṃ dukkhaṃ, tad eva tvaṃ gahapati allīno, tad eva tvaṃ gahapati ajjhūpagato' ti.
an10.93:14.1: ‘Yaṃ kho pana bhante kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, tad aniccaṃ,
an10.93:14.3: yaṃ dukkhaṃ, taṃ "n' etaṃ mama n' eso 'ham asmi na m' eso attā" ti: evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ,
an10.93:14.4: tassa ca uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāmī' ti.
an10.93:15.1: Evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā nisīdiṃsu. 7.
an10.93:15.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati te paribbājake tuṇhībhūte maṅkubhūte pattakkhandhe adhomukhe pajjhāyante appaṭibhāne viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yāvatako ahosi tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi.
an10.93:15.4: evaṃ kho te gahapati moghapurisā kālena kālaṃ saha dhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetabbā' ti.
an10.93:16.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
an10.93:16.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. 8.
an10.93:17.1: Atha kho Bhagavā acirapakkante Anāthapiṇḍike gahapatimhi bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.93:17.2: Yo pi so bhikkhave bhikkhu vassasatupasampanno imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, so pi evam evaṃ aññatitthiye paribbājake saha dhammena suniggahītaṃ niggaṇheyya, yathā taṃ Anāthapiṇḍikena gahapatinā niggahītā
